g.text: Figure 3 — UML Component diagram — application components and interfaces
The four packages are the Spring Modulith application modules. Spring Security remains an
adapter/runtime boundary: Authentication, SecurityContext and session types stop before
OperatorContextPort. Detector implementations also stop behind the project-owned
RiskSignalDetectorPort and emit only derived RiskSignalEvidence. `specgraph.analysis.detectors`
is the typed Stage-1 selection authority; legacy detector profiles are bootstrap aliases only
when that property is absent. Spring owns bean lifecycle, the factory/registry resolves leaves
or the bounded Composite, and child failure fails Stage 1 rather than disappearing silently.
CustomerReviewQueryPort bounds the operator surface independently of the complete
CustomerActivityPort snapshot used by analysis. AnalysisContextBuilder is an application-layer
projection: Stage 1 and Stage 2 retain complete CustomerSnapshot semantics, then exact full-history
totals are separated from bounded model-facing details immediately before AnalysisModelPort. GoF
Adapter labels identify boundary translation roles; Strategy seams identify interchangeable
implementations; the analysis application service acts as a Facade over orchestration.
